statement: Pinned rnconrad device-side emulator initializes each Nunchuk or Classic accessory by copying a 16-byte calibration template to both register offsets 0x20 and 0x30 within its 0xA4 extension register space. This proves how that emulator initializes extension calibration windows, not a physical checksum, layout or valid retail reference value.

applicability.revision: Historical software emulator; physical hardware variant not established
applicability.scope: Source lines 795-809 with template declarations at 12-21; no real-device dump or checksum verification. May be a compatibility constant.
